## prompt-4-final-ind

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-ind.md`](../prompts/prompt-ind.md),
adapting the `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-4-final-protocol.md` convention.
Runs in stage `trial-ind/final-ind/`. There is no `publication` subdirectory under
`final-ind`.*

Author the **Stage 4 final IND** into `trial-ind/final-ind/`. Context and
formatting reach maximum quality here. Carry over `full-ind`, then double-verify
that all context and formatting is improved, implementing every correction
identified in `full-ind`.

**Senior-author polish (learn from and implement the author's techniques).**
- `\clearpage` so each major section is self-standing and no line is stranded
  across a page boundary; avoid a single short line carried alone to the next page.
- Table column widths tuned per the amount of text per column; every cell
  `>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{..}`; every table at the body measure.
- `\vspace` / `\hspace` and `\needspace` used throughout figures and text to
  remove large empty white space without overcrowding (some white space is fine).
- `\RaggedRight` interword spacing so words are evenly spaced and no text runs off
  the right margin; long URLs break on any character.
- Avoid lines with a single or two words; correct any `SS` to `§`; single dashes
  only (no em, double, or triple dashes).
- Each figure re-verified twice for overlaps, arrow looseness, and box spacing,
  matching the Python Mermaid complexity exactly.

**Files (one commit each).** `indstyle.sty`, `main.tex`, `references.bib`,
`README.md`, then the 12 `sections/sec-*.tex`. The second-to-last commit fixes all
remaining errors; the last commit ships `final-ind-LaTeX.zip` and
`output-final-ind.md`, then performs the repository-wide updates (root `README.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md`, `releases.md`, `prompts/output-ind.md`, v4.3.0).

**Sources used (Rule 5).** `../full-ind/` (refined here, not overwritten);
`../mermaid/` (the grayscale figure catalog at full fidelity);
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication` (the `\clearpage` / `\vspace` /
table-width proof-reading techniques and the clinical data);
`trial-documents/final-paper/publication/sections/sec-08-references-backmatter.tex`
(the back matter adapted here); `trial-ind/inputs/*`. No `png` / `jpg`.
